review.summary: Phase 22 chunk `connection-compatibility` is genuinely implemented, not inventoried. The runtime graph delta is surgically minimal and independently verified: exactly four frozen nodes change (`s012061`, `s012067` vocabularies; `s010462`, `s010504` union tails), the three new components live in a dedicated generated `red_team_management` namespace, old union prefixes are preserved byte-for-byte against the untouched `contracts/native-union-variants.json` via a trimming verifier, and the 23 frozen default bindings are unchanged (`response-defaults.json` counts identical, only input hashes rebound; a test asserts no `ZodDefault` node is added). `crates/scm-sdk/src/validation.rs` changes only by adding the three reviewed Vertex request patterns, and `tools/generate_models.py:897` now requires the native regex set to equal `REGEX_SOURCES | MANAGEMENT_REGEX_SOURCES` exactly, so an unreviewed pattern fails closed. The overlay compiler fails closed on unknown vocabulary, unknown patterns, non-nullable `anyOf`, unreviewed discriminators and double application. `--require-through-phase 22` now enforces real artifacts (manifest adoption, overlay source bindings, graph nodes, 13 named Rust wire-test bindings, offline live boundary) instead of passing on plan evidence. Evidence is verified, not trusted: the recorded check set contains executed `cargo test` output showing `red_team_management_contracts` 13/13 and `red_team_management_models` 5/5 passing on 1.89.0 and 1.99.0 across `red-team` and `red-team,arbitrary_precision`, alongside the whole pre-existing suite (23 frozen defaults, 47 vendor operations, G25 projection tests) still green. All five target response declarations, both response modes, redacted/unredacted credential shapes, hybrid/untagged/missing-discriminator union precedence, explicit-tag precedence, omission/null/value and secret redaction in Debug/transport/validation errors are covered by real fixtures. No blocker or high finding. The shortfalls are precision and documentation: the new typed projections are a second, undocumented projection mechanism that the generated `docs/G25_COMPATIBILITY.md` inventory still excludes while claiming to list "every request-reachable projection model"; the legacy node IDs for projections and union tails are hardcoded with no binding to their expected baseline components or completeness check; the enum extension ledger is hand-written rather than derived; and several guard branches (wire-test binding, ledger disagreement) and the public enum `Unknown`→named transitions lack negative/match-based fixtures.

findings.description: The generated projection documentation is now incomplete for the SDK it describes. This chunk adds 12 vendor typed-projection field occurrences with exactly the same typed-over-raw precedence (tools/red_team_management_models.py:21-28; generated.rs:8929-9010 shows the typed field serialized ahead of the raw extension and the extension suppressed), affecting request-reachable models AuthConfigRequestVariant3 (s010755), BasicAuthAuthConfig (s010721), RestConnectionParams (s010789), StreamingConnectionParams (s010821), WebSocketConnectionParams (s010824) and ConnectionParamsRequestVariant2 (s010829). None of them appear in the sentence 'This typed-over-raw precedence also applies intentionally to every request-reachable projection model: ...' or in the 55-row table at lines 21-26, because tools/g25_fixtures.py:266-278 builds its projection inventory from the data-plane augmentation only and never applies the management overlay. The adjacent claim that 'The reviewed legacy/vendor schema pairings are pinned separately in projection-bindings.json and generation fails if they change' is likewise untrue for the management pairings. A consumer reading this document will conclude basic_username/basic_password/audio_request_json/audio_curl keep raw extension precedence.
findings.required_fix: Either register the management projections in the G25 projection inventory (extend tools/g25_fixtures.py/tools/g25_report.py and re-pin the partition test) or add an explicitly generated management projection section listing the six schemas and four fields, and qualify the 'every request-reachable projection model' sentence so it names its corpus. Add a test asserting the documented projection model set equals the union of both mechanisms.

findings.description: PROJECTIONS (lines 21-28) and UNION_BRANCHES (line 29) bind frozen runtime nodes by bare schema ID with no assertion that each ID is the component it is believed to be, and with no completeness check. The vendor component name in each tuple is only used to read the vendor fragment; augment_models (lines 163-166) rejects only an already-present field, so a wrong or stale legacy ID would silently graft typed audio/Basic-Auth fields onto an unrelated baseline model, and a frozen node that also carries these vendor wire keys but is omitted from the dict stays raw-only with no diagnostic. This is weaker than the mechanism the plan points at (docs/red-team-management-0.86-plan.md:110-113), where contracts/compatibility/g25/projection-bindings.json pins legacy/vendor pairings and generation fails if they change. The current pairings are correct in this source state (verified through generated.rs:8923, 9303, 12875, 162482, 171968, 184366), so this is precision, not an active defect.
findings.required_fix: Add the expected baseline model or root name to each PROJECTIONS/UNION_BRANCHES row and assert it against the generator's node/declaration names during build; add a completeness check that no other frozen node reachable from the affected roots accepts these vendor wire keys without a projection, plus regressions in tools/test_red_team_management_models.py for a wrong ID and an omitted node.

findings.description: ledger()['runtimeEnumExtensions'] hardcodes {'s012061': ['VERTEX_AI','N8N'], 's012067': ['REALTIME']}, while extend_nodes (lines 125-129) derives the actual added values from the pinned vendor enum and de-duplicates against the frozen values. The recorded overlay provenance is therefore not derived from the computation it documents. It is accurate for this pinned source (schema_graph.json s012061 gains exactly VERTEX_AI and N8N after the pre-existing CUSTOM_TARGET_ADAPTER; s012067 gains REALTIME), and the source is hash-pinned at line 16, but a re-pin could silently widen the runtime vocabulary while the published ledger still claims two values. test_runtime_changes_are_only_reviewed_nodes_and_two_unions asserts only which node IDs changed, not what changed.
findings.required_fix: Compute runtimeEnumExtensions from the actual applied delta in extend_nodes, or assert in tools/test_red_team_management_models.py that the hardcoded map equals the set difference between the extended and frozen enum values for both nodes.

findings.description: verify_runtime_adoption's two strongest new guards have no negative test. Lines 664-667 require all 13 MANAGEMENT_WIRE_TESTS function names in crates/scm-sdk/tests/red_team_management_contracts.rs, and lines 657-659 reject a disagreement between the union-extension ledger and the overlay ledger, but test_runtime_adoption_rejects_unbound_or_stale_overlay_sources (tools/test_red_team_management.py:315-332) only exercises generator hash, empty bindings and a tampered binding hash. The analogous data-plane guard does have test_wire_bindings_fail_on_missing_extra_tampered_or_unexecutable_operations. A renamed or deleted wire test would therefore not be proven to fail the phase gate.
findings.required_fix: Add regressions that patch the contracts test source to drop/rename one MANAGEMENT_WIRE_TESTS entry and that mutate contracts/red-team-management-union-extensions.json['extensions'], each expecting an explicit ValueError from verify_runtime_adoption.

findings.description: The plan requires observable Unknown-to-named-variant transitions to be covered by match-based consumer fixtures (docs/red-team-management-0.86-plan.md:107-108). The two union tails are covered (Variant5/Variant3 matched explicitly), but the public enum transitions are not: generated.rs:174718-174746 and 174774-174792 now map "VERTEX_AI"/"N8N" to TargetConnectionType::VERTEXAI/N8N and "REALTIME" to ResponseMode::REALTIME instead of Unknown(value), and runtime_connection_and_response_mode_vocabulary_are_distinct only asserts string-level validation::parse results. A TargetResponse round-trip cannot distinguish the two since Unknown also serializes back to the same string.
findings.required_fix: Add match-based assertions that the public TargetConnectionType/ResponseMode enums deserialize the three new strings to their named variants (and an unrelated string to Unknown), in crates/scm-sdk/tests/red_team_management_models.rs.

findings.description: The decision to keep the frozen shared root TargetResponseSchema for all five target operations, where 0.86.0 declares TargetResponseSchema, TargetRedactSchema and TargetSchema (contracts/vendor/red-team-management/0.86.0/openapi.json; tools/test_red_team_management.py:358-363 records only the vendor mapping), is captured solely as the one-line responsePolicy prose 'Frozen roots retained'. The plan asked for a reviewed compatible shared superset or explicit operation-local aliases. The retention is well founded (the frozen TypeScript baseline itself uses TargetResponseSchema for all five, per contracts/operations.json:91029, 91753, 93307, 93777, 94081) and the delta is proven by all_five_operations_preserve_declared_sensitive_response_shapes including masked GET bodies, but no artifact records the field-level comparison of the three vendor schemas against the retained root, so a future reviewer cannot re-derive why the superset claim holds.
findings.required_fix: Record an explicit per-operation declaration table (vendor schema, retained SDK root, superset justification, fixture name) in the overlay ledger or the vendor compatibility-decisions artifact, and assert it in tools/test_red_team_management.py.

findings.description: Line 1067 serializes the management overlay ledger into outputs[management.OVERLAY] and line 1105 unconditionally overwrites the same key with the sourceBindings-augmented ledger, so the first write is dead. Separately, red_team_management_models.py:153-155 derives the new module's header and import line by exact string replacement on generated output; if the generator's import list or header text changes, the import replacement silently no-ops (caught only indirectly by clippy -D warnings) and the header replacement silently leaves the wrong provenance comment on a file whose NOTICE attribution matters.
findings.required_fix: Delete the dead write at tools/generate_models.py:1067, and make the header/import rewrite assert that each replacement actually matched (raise if the needle is absent).

findings.description: The missing-space-before-numeral defect recorded as a residual low finding on this same file in the accepted phase 21 review (docs/phase-status.json:5426) is still present in tool-emitted prose and operator-facing text inside this chunk's scope: 'runtime_adopted_phase22'/'pinned_for_phase22_not_runtime_adopted' and the overlay-owner string (lines 522, 525), 'phase23 must exercise old consumers' (line 592), 'Phase22 offline scope cannot claim a current live receipt' (line 680) and 'Phase23–25 qualification evidence is not implemented' (line 699). The adoptionState token is also emitted into contracts/airs-active-sources.json:66 and asserted in tools/test_red_team_management.py:24, so correcting it requires a coordinated identifier change.
findings.required_fix: Normalise the human-readable messages (lines 525, 592, 680, 699 and the docstring/help text at 423, 694) to 'phase 22'/'phase 23'; if the adoptionState/runtimeAdoption enumeration tokens are kept as identifiers, state that explicitly in a comment so a future maintainer does not re-report it.

evidence: Executed Rust evidence, not prose: docs/checks/phase-22-rust-1.89.0-red-team.json:90 contains 'running 13 tests' for tests/red_team_management_contracts.rs (all five operations, both response modes, redaction, profiling filter, projection precedence) and 'running 5 tests' for tests/red_team_management_models.rs, both 'test result: ok ... 0 failed', with the pre-existing suite still green (169 lib tests, 'all_23_frozen_defaults_validate_under_both_response_policies', 'all_47_vendor_operations_match_independent_wire_contracts_under_both_response_policies', 8 g25 projection tests). The same feature set passes on 1.99.0 and with serde_json/arbitrary_precision (checks file entries at lines 816-923).

Minimal runtime delta is proven, not asserted: tools/test_red_team_management_models.py:16-23 computes the frozen-vs-extended graph diff and asserts the touched node set is exactly {s012061, s012067, s010462, s010504}, that no overlay node is a ZodDefault, and that each extended union's variants[:-1] equals the frozen list. The committed graph matches: schema_graph.json s010462 = [s010463, s010467, s010481, s010490, smp_bc45d353b11579547ea9cf9e] and s012067 gains only REALTIME.

Old union pins stay byte-identical: contracts/native-union-variants.json is unmodified; tools/red_team_management_models.py:176-192 trims exactly the reviewed tail (asserting sourceIndex, schema, rustVariant and rustType) before delegating to the strict comparator, and test_union_extension_verifier_preserves_exact_legacy_prefix proves prefix reorder, tail tamper and missing-tail all raise.

Fail-closed source compilation: tools/red_team_management_models.py:42-46 rejects a symlinked or changed YAML pin and a normalized-JSON mismatch; compile() (73-117) rejects unreviewed keywords, patterns outside the three-element allowlist, non-nullable anyOf, and any discriminator other than the reviewed client_session const. test_source_fragment_unknown_keyword_or_pattern_fails_closed exercises both a widened pattern and an added maxLength.

Validation change is exactly the reviewed scope: crates/scm-sdk/src/validation.rs:1063-1066 adds only the three Vertex patterns, and tools/generate_models.py:894-897 requires the native regex literal set to equal REGEX_SOURCES | MANAGEMENT_REGEX_SOURCES exactly, so adding or dropping a pattern on either side fails generation.

Request strictness with G25 response tolerance both hold: red_team_management_models.rs:18-40 shows 'BAD ID', 'a/b' and 'opaque-engine' rejected in Mode::Request and preserved verbatim in both response modes, while a numeric project_id is still rejected in Mode::Response; red_team_management_contracts.rs:106-125 repeats this through TargetCreateRequestSchema and asserts the error text never contains the fixture secret.

Legacy union order preserved: red_team_management_contracts.rs:195-240 and 242-266 prove a hybrid vertex+api_key object still selects Variant1 and an untagged complete stateful config still selects Variant1, while {} and {"type":"stateless"} select Variant2; red_team_management_models.rs:68-93 proves the validator and serde agree on 2/1/3 for {}, the stateful pair, and an explicitly tagged client_session with an unknown key, in all three modes.

client_session is opt-in with no injected default: MultiTurnClientSessionConfig::parse(json!({}), Request) errors (red_team_management_models.rs:69); the node is a bare ZodLiteral with 'type' forced into required (red_team_management_models.py:84-88, 107-108) and test_default_is_not_injected_into_client_session pins the node shape.

Frozen defaults untouched: contracts/response-defaults.json:17-21 still records 23/8/15 bindings with only input hashes rebound to the new schema_graph.json (3bfcae4d...), matching the hash recorded in the overlay sourceBindings and in contracts/compatibility/g25/audit.json:22; red_team_management_contracts.rs:158-172 shows ws_response_timeout 110 and basic_auth_location HEADER appear only in Mode::Response while ResponseWithoutDefaults returns the server bytes exactly.

Projection fallback is lossless and non-narrowing: generated.rs:8933-8972 keeps the raw value in the extension map when the typed decode fails and 8996-9010 gives the typed value precedence while suppressing the duplicate; red_team_management_models.rs:96-117 round-trips null, 9, ["secret"], {"secret":...} and a string through all three modes, and red_team_management_contracts.rs:536-565 proves Patch::Value/Null/Unset semantics including restoration of the raw collision.

Phase gate now requires implementation: tools/red_team_management.py:703-708 makes --require-through-phase 22 verify manifest usedForGeneration, the overlay generator identity and every source binding's actual bytes, the union ledger agreement, the public model nodes' presence in the runtime graph, all 13 named wire tests in the contracts test file, and the offline live boundary (zero current liveVerified, no contracts/live-evidence.json, no leaked liveEvidence rows). The recorded run passes at checks file lines 230-250 with native_exports/qualification reporting liveVerified 0.

Secret safety: every new generated type writes '([REDACTED])' from Debug (red_team_management.rs:85-89, 234-238, 350-354), and the fixtures assert the synthetic secret never appears in typed Debug, TransportRequest Debug (contracts.rs:297), validation errors (116) or client errors (531). The fixture credentials are synthetic literals and the private-material receipt check passed over 1934 git-visible files.
limitations: Read-only tools only (Read/Glob/Grep): I could not execute any command, so I verified the recorded check receipts' contents and consistency rather than re-running them. I also could not compute SHA-256 values, so the stated reviewed source hash a5f3038... and the checks-file hash dcc8741... are taken as given; I confirmed the checks file self-reports that phase/source and source_unchanged: true.

No git diff was available, so 'what changed' was inferred from the working-tree state, the git status snapshot, generator reproducibility (`generate_models.py --check`, `red_team_management.py --check`, `response_defaults.py --check`, `g25_*.py --check` all recorded as exit 0) and cross-artifact hash agreement, not from a line-level diff.

The schema_graph.json is minified on one line; I inspected the four changed nodes and one overlay node by targeted regex extraction rather than reading the whole graph, and relied on the passing generator --check for the remaining overlay node bodies.

Chunk-scoped review: crates/scm-sdk/src/airs/red_team/targets.rs (profiling filter, rustdoc on status/profiling_status), NOTICE/manifest/native ledgers and CI documentation belong to the target-filtering and typed-connections chunks and were not scored here, even though the shared contracts test file exercises the filter. Phase-24 changelog/release-note obligations and phase-23 cumulative qualification are explicitly later deliverables and were not judged.

The new projection fields and union/enum tails are covered by hand-written Rust fixtures; they are deliberately outside the independently derived G25 corpus (tools/g25_fixtures.py:266-278 applies only the data-plane augmentation), so there is no independent-oracle coverage of the 12 new projection occurrences in this chunk. The check receipts record cargo exit codes plus full test output for the 1.89.0 red-team run; the other three feature-set receipts were spot-checked at command level only.
All evidence here is offline/static or local-transport: no live service acceptance is claimed or demonstrated, consistent with the phase 22 offline boundary.
